en-US.description: Centralized SSH gateway for AI agents with MCP access, credential custody, fine-grained authorization, and full auditing.
en-US.longDescription: OneSSH is a centralized SSH gateway written in Go: a single binary that provides stateless Streamable HTTP MCP, OAuth 2.1 authorization, a management API, a live activity stream, and a browser terminal. SSH private keys and passwords are stored encrypted with AES-256-GCM and never leave the gateway; agents reach remote hosts through revocable tokens bound to specific hosts and permissions, and every call and permission denial is recorded in the audit log.

zh-CN.description: 面向 AI Agent 的集中式 SSH 网关，提供 MCP 接入、凭据托管、细粒度授权与全程审计。
zh-CN.longDescription: OneSSH 是用 Go 编写的集中式 SSH 网关：单个二进制同时提供无状态 Streamable HTTP MCP、OAuth 2.1 授权、管理 API、实时活动流和浏览器终端。SSH 私钥与密码经 AES-256-GCM 加密存储，凭据不出网关；Agent 通过绑定主机与权限范围的令牌访问远端主机，令牌随时可撤销；每次调用与权限拒绝均写入审计日志。
